description: Finds old, empty, or tiny Claude Code session files that are candidates for deletion.

evals.name: Find cleanup candidates, no deletion
evals.prompt: Find old and empty sessions I could delete to save disk space.
evals.expected_output: Lists candidates (empty/tiny/old sessions) via the cleanup command, without deleting anything; presents total reclaimable space.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a single explicit delete
evals.prompt: Delete this specific session, ID abc123.
evals.expected_output: Declines and points to session-delete instead, per its own stated exclusion.
